handoff: Approve: decide takes back a merged story's released claim (worktree still present) so the cleanup records it done; cockpit rows show item titles for multi-row stories. Both wanted items test-proven; 2 minor notes.

findings.title: Stories already closed with `norn story close` stay recorded active
findings.detail:
The take-back needs `story.worktree?.exists`. Stories closed with `norn story close` before this fix (gh-222, gh-271, gh-292 in the issue's Observed) have no worktree, so they are never taken back and their Check item 'issue closed — the round stays finished' stays. The Wanted line 'When a story's PR is seen merged into the base, the story is recorded done' is met for the repro path (approve, merge, sync tick), not for these existing stories. The handoff lists it under Not proven yet; the guard is what stops a re-cleanup loop.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: The person lands `status: done` on the base for those stories by hand, or a follow-up issue settles them.

findings.title: A failed worktree removal makes every tick re-acquire and re-run the cleanup
findings.detail:
cleanupMerged (packages/cli/src/runtime/act/lifecycle.ts:283) deletes the claim ref even when the story worktree's removal throws. On the next sync tick the worktree still exists and the claim is none, so the take-back fires again. This is a retry rather than a race (the acquire is create-only), and it ends once the removal succeeds, but each attempt re-archives and re-attempts the record.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Leave as is unless it is seen in practice.
